media.title: The Washington Times, 31 October 1938 — Kaper’s Machine Gun Department anecdote
media.description: Gossip item 'Machine Gun Department' in The Washington Times (Washington, D.C.), 31 October 1938: Bronisław Kaper, MGM composer (Mutiny on the Bounty, San Francisco, Escapade, The Great Waltz) and 'possibly the most brilliant pianist in the colony', who made an exhaustive study of American gangsters and would rather talk about Machine Gun Jack McGurn than about music. Source: SRC0052 / Library of Congress, Chronicling America.
media.altText: Newspaper clipping from The Washington Times, 31 October 1938.
